_comment: Deploy these EventBridge rules via AWS CLI or CloudFormation. Replace EC2_INSTANCE_ID and ACCOUNT_ID with real values.

rules.Name: signup-success-triggers-ec2-start
rules.Description: Start EC2 when a user completes signup (Lambda setPassword publishes this event)

rules.Name: login-success-triggers-ec2-start
rules.Description: Start EC2 when a user logs in with correct password (Lambda phoneLogin publishes this event)

rules.Name: ec2-auto-sleep-daily-backup
rules.Description: Backup: stop EC2 daily at midnight UTC (6:30 AM IST) in case inactivity check misses

rules.Name: ec2-inactivity-check-every-minute
rules.Description: Trigger checkInactivity Lambda every 1 minute — Lambda reads Firestore and stops EC2 if idle for 15+ min

deploy_commands._comment: Run these commands to create the rules (replace all PLACEHOLDERS first)
deploy_commands.rule_4: aws events put-rule --name ec2-inactivity-check-every-minute --schedule-expression 'rate(1 minute)' --state ENABLED
deploy_commands.grant_lambda: aws lambda add-permission --function-name checkInactivity --statement-id EventBridgeTrigger --action lambda:InvokeFunction --principal events.amazonaws.com --source-arn arn:aws:events:REGION:ACCOUNT_ID:rule/ec2-inactivity-check-every-minute
